braceletRules.name: 全局手串结构规则
braceletRules.description: 所有水晶手串案例共享同一套产品结构、几何、材质和风格一致性约束。不同风格只能改变拍摄方式，不能改变产品本体。

zh: 不允许前大后小的夸张透视

braceletRules.promptAppendixZh: 保持完整闭环手串、统一珠径和对称结构，呈现真实珠宝摄影比例、真实天然水晶质感、合理透视关系和清晰商业摄影表达。
braceletRules.promptAppendixEn: Keep a complete closed-loop bracelet with uniform bead diameter and symmetrical structure, showing realistic jewelry photography proportions, authentic natural crystal material quality, reasonable perspective, and polished commercial photography expression.

products.name: 紫水晶
products.description: 适合表达神秘、优雅、疗愈感和轻奢礼赠属性，画面重点放在紫色晶体通透度、珠体光泽和女性化高级感。
products.materialSpecZh: 紫水晶珠体需要呈现天然紫色晶体、通透层次、细微冰裂纹和矿物内含物，表面具有真实抛光宝石反射。
products.materialSpecEn: amethyst beads with natural purple crystal translucency, subtle icy fractures, mineral inclusions, and polished gemstone reflections
products.colorSpecZh: 颜色以自然紫色、深浅渐变和冷调高光为主。
products.colorSpecEn: natural purple tones with subtle depth variation and cool refined highlights
products.textureSpecZh: 纹理表现细微冰裂、矿物内含物、通透晶体层次和抛光表面。
products.textureSpecEn: subtle icy fractures, mineral inclusions, translucent crystal depth, and polished surfaces

products.name: 黄水晶
products.description: 适合表达温暖、开运、明亮和礼物属性，画面重点放在金黄色通透度、暖调光泽和积极能量感。
products.materialSpecZh: 黄水晶珠体需要呈现天然金黄色晶体、温暖通透度、内部矿物纹理和干净抛光表面，避免廉价黄色塑料感。
products.materialSpecEn: citrine beads with natural golden-yellow crystal translucency, warm clarity, internal mineral texture, and clean polished gemstone surfaces
products.colorSpecZh: 颜色以天然金黄色、暖调透明感和柔和香槟高光为主。
products.colorSpecEn: natural golden-yellow tones with warm translucency and soft champagne highlights
products.textureSpecZh: 纹理表现内部矿物纹路、清透晶体结构、干净抛光表面和温润反射。
products.textureSpecEn: internal mineral lines, clear crystal structure, clean polished surfaces, and warm refined reflections

products.name: 黑曜石
products.description: 适合表达沉稳、力量感、守护寓意和男士饰品属性，画面重点放在深黑镜面质感、边缘高光和低调高级感。
products.materialSpecZh: 黑曜石珠体需要呈现天然深黑色宝石质感、镜面抛光反射、可见的边缘高光和真实晶石深度，避免黑色塑料块感。
products.materialSpecEn: obsidian beads with natural deep black gemstone character, mirror-polished reflections, visible edge highlights, and believable stone depth
products.colorSpecZh: 颜色以深黑色、冷调边缘高光和低调镜面反射为主。
products.colorSpecEn: deep black tones with cool edge highlights and restrained mirror reflections
products.textureSpecZh: 纹理表现镜面抛光质感、黑色晶石深度、细窄高光和真实石质反射。
products.textureSpecEn: mirror-polished texture, deep black stone depth, narrow highlights, and realistic stone reflections

styles.name: 奢侈品广告风
styles.description: 以高级静物、低饱和背景、精确高光和广告大片构图塑造收藏价值。
styles.promptStyleZh: 采用奢侈品珠宝广告语言，画面克制、道具极少、留白高级，突出水晶通透度、珠体轮廓、精确高光和收藏价值。
styles.promptStyleEn: Use luxury jewelry advertising language with restrained styling, minimal props, premium negative space, precise highlights, and a strong focus on crystal translucency, bead silhouette, and collectible value.

styles.name: 小红书种草风
styles.description: 以真实生活方式场景、干净道具和社媒封面构图建立日常佩戴想象。
styles.promptStyleZh: 采用真实但经过专业整理的生活方式照片语言，道具轻量、干净、服务主体，画面保留社媒封面需要的呼吸感。
styles.promptStyleEn: Use a realistic yet professionally styled lifestyle photo language with clean supporting props, social media cover breathing room, and a natural approachable mood.

styles.name: 电商白底风
styles.description: 以干净白底、完整商品结构、准确颜色和高可读性服务电商转化。
styles.promptStyleZh: 采用专业电商主图语言，背景纯净，主体居中且完整，轮廓边缘清晰，材质和颜色必须准确可信。
styles.promptStyleEn: Use professional ecommerce product-main-image language with a clean background, centered complete subject, crisp edges, accurate material, and trustworthy color.

styles.name: 礼赠场景风
styles.description: 以礼盒、包装纸、节日或纪念日氛围表现送礼价值和情绪记忆点。
styles.promptStyleZh: 采用高级礼赠场景语言，包装、纸品和轻量道具只负责强化送礼氛围，手串始终是最清晰的视觉中心。
styles.promptStyleEn: Use a premium gifting scene language where packaging, paper goods, and restrained props enhance the gift atmosphere while the bracelet remains the clearest visual focus.

cases.title: 紫水晶奢侈品广告风
cases.summary: 以深紫色丝绒、冷调高光和珠宝大片构图表现紫水晶的神秘与收藏属性。
cases.prompt: 紫水晶手串作为画面主体，置于深紫色丝绒与浅色石材之间，背景克制、道具极少，保留大量干净留白。紫水晶珠体呈现天然紫色晶体、通透层次、细微冰裂和矿物内含物，表面有真实抛光宝石反射。画面需要保持完整闭环手串、统一珠径和对称结构，呈现真实天然水晶质感、真实珠宝摄影比例和合理透视关系。主体以自然弧线位于画面下三分之一，丝绒褶皱和石材边缘只作为背景层次，视线集中在紫色晶体透明度和手串轮廓。使用大面积柔光箱形成柔和主光，再用窄边缘光勾出珠体外轮廓，高光控制在珠体上方，避免过曝。画面只展示单条手串，整体是可直接用于商品销售、内容种草或品牌展示的商业摄影表达，背景和道具只服务产品，不出现文字、水印、多余 logo 或人物佩戴效果。
cases.promptEn: Create a commercial jewelry image of an amethyst bracelet. Place it between deep purple velvet and pale stone, with restrained styling, minimal props, and generous clean negative space. Show natural purple crystal translucency, subtle icy fractures, mineral inclusions, polished gemstone reflections, and refined bead-edge highlights. Keep the product as a complete closed-loop bracelet with uniform bead diameter, symmetrical structure, realistic jewelry photography proportions, authentic natural crystal material quality, and a reasonable perspective relationship. Position the bracelet as an elegant natural arc in the lower third of the frame, using velvet folds and a stone edge only as subtle background layers. Use a large softbox as the main light and a narrow rim light to outline the beads, keeping highlights controlled and avoiding overexposure. Show only one bracelet. The final image should deliver polished commercial photography expression for product selling, social content, or brand presentation, with no text, watermark, extra logo, wrist, hand, or model-wearing effect.

cases.prompt: 黄水晶手串作为画面主体，放在浅木色桌面上，旁边有咖啡杯、米色笔记本和少量干花，场景自然但保持整洁。黄水晶珠体呈现天然金黄色晶体、温暖通透度、内部矿物纹理和干净抛光表面，避免廉价黄色塑料感。画面需要保持完整闭环手串、统一珠径和对称结构，呈现真实天然水晶质感、真实珠宝摄影比例和合理透视关系。采用 4:5 竖版构图，手串位于画面中心，杯子和笔记本形成轻量三角关系，留出标题裁切空间。使用早晨自然侧光，色温偏暖，阴影柔和，让黄水晶的金黄色通透而不发灰。画面只展示单条手串，整体是可直接用于商品销售、内容种草或品牌展示的商业摄影表达，背景和道具只服务产品，不出现文字、水印、多余 logo 或人物佩戴效果。
cases.promptEn: Create a commercial jewelry image of an citrine bracelet. Place it on a pale wooden table with a coffee cup, beige notebook, and a few dried flowers, keeping the scene natural but carefully arranged. Show natural golden-yellow crystal translucency, warm clarity, internal mineral texture, clean polished gemstone surfaces, and soft champagne highlights. Keep the product as a complete closed-loop bracelet with uniform bead diameter, symmetrical structure, realistic jewelry photography proportions, authentic natural crystal material quality, and a reasonable perspective relationship. Use a vertical 4:5 composition with the bracelet at the center, while the cup and notebook create a light triangular relationship and leave cover text space.
